_source: KLE Technological University, CSE-AI, Year 2023-27 batch. Semesters I-VI transcribed from the official 'Curriculum Structure-Overall' sheet (Form FMCD2009/2.0). Semesters VII-VIII transcribed from 'CSEAI_VII-VIII_Structure-2026-28-07-2026.docx' and 'CSEAI-VII-VIII_updated_Scheme_24-08-2026_To_BGM.docx' (the 2026 curriculum revision, which added Agentic AI and Cryptography & Network Security as core Semester-VII courses, and recoded Embedded Intelligent Systems / Generative AI in Semester VI). Course topics for courses that also appear with full syllabi in the 2025-29 batch master document ('Master_copy_2025-29_Curriculum.pdf') are carried over where the course name/content is continuous across batches (noted per-course below); otherwise topics are omitted rather than invented. UPDATED with real unit-wise topics from All_Lesson_Plans_Merged_Sequence_Wise.pdf (2023-27 batch lesson plans) and corrected/cross-checked against CSE_AI-BOS-MOM.docx (the Board of Studies Minutes of Meeting, 18 April 2026, the authoritative approval record). Where the lesson-plan document uses a different course code than the curriculum-structure sheet for the same course (by title and content), both codes are recorded and the discrepancy is noted rather than silently resolved. Cryptography & Network Security topics added from CSE_AI-BOS-MOM.docx. Real topics also added for the elective-catalog entries Big Data Analytics (26ECAE417), Cloud Computing (24ECAE317), Cyber Security (24ECSE318), Software Testing (24ECSE402) and Wireless and Mobile Networks (25ECAE341), all from the same lesson-plan document.

courses.title: Agentic AI
courses._note: Added to the curriculum in the 2026 revision (26-prefix code) -- the department's own first move toward the exact gap this project analyses.
topics: Foundations of Agentic AI (agent loop, plan-act-observe-revise)
Agent frameworks, tools, skills and memory (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen)
Model Context Protocol (MCP) and governed connectors
Multi-agent orchestration and parallel task execution (swarms)
Agentic runtime patterns (OpenCLA/OpenClaw), audit logging, checkpoints
Learning agents: RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, Reflexion
Safety and governance: approval gates, audit logs, evaluation

courses.title: Cryptography & Network Security
courses._note: Added to the curriculum in the 2026-27 revision, approved by the Board of Studies on 18 April 2026 (CSE_AI-BOS-MOM.docx). Code corrected to 24ECAC403 to match that approved table (an earlier structure draft used 26ECAC402 for the same course).
topics: Introduction: OSI security architecture, secure design principles, classic crypto (substitution/transposition)
Cryptographic algorithms: symmetric (stream ciphers, Feistel, AES, DES) and asymmetric (Diffie-Hellman, ElGamal, ECC, post-quantum intro)
Data integrity and key management: hash functions, MAC/HMAC, digital signatures, PKI, zero-knowledge proofs
Authentication and authorization: MFA, SSO, RBAC, firewalls/IDS, cloud access control, Zero Trust
Application and transport security: PGP, S/MIME, SSL/TLS, SSH, Kerberos, OAuth/JWT
Network and wireless security: IPSec, 802.11 security, WPA2/WPA3, 5G network security
courses.topics_source: real, from CSE_AI-BOS-MOM.docx's own Course Content section for this course (that section header uses yet a third code, 26ECAC305, for the same course -- recorded here as a further example of code inconsistency across the university's own documents, alongside the earlier 26ECAC402 draft code)

notes: KLE Tech course codes encode the catalog year a course was introduced or last revised (e.g. 26ECAC401 -> 2026, 18ECSP101 -> 2018). Electives (XX-prefixed placeholder codes) have no concrete year until a student selects a specific option from the catalog, so they are excluded from the staleness check.
